one_month_reasoning: Window 2026-11-18 to 2026-12-17. The Q4 print (Nov 12) is behind us: revenue guide midpoint $11.1B below the $11.41B consensus, EPS guide above, 10+ target cuts; post-earnings drift after a guide below consensus is mildly negative, but the stock already fell ~35% from $507 (Oct 9) to $333 (Nov 6) in an AI-capex/midterm rout (src 7), and sharp drawdowns in semicap have tended to partially reverse. In-window events: NVIDIA's quarterly report (late November; AI-capex read-through, either direction), the December FOMC, SEMI's year-end equipment forecast at SEMICON Japan (mid-December; likely to confirm >30% 2027 growth already in statements), Micron's FQ1 report near the window end (DRAM capex read). No AMAT-specific scheduled event. Net: centered at ~$350 (no directional call), monthly vol ~18-19% (64%/3.5) with fatter tails (20% weight on a 28% vol regime) given the stock's recent 6-14% daily moves.

reasoning: Base-rates lane. (1) Setup: AMAT ran from ~$203 (Nov-2025 low) to a $739.67 intraday high (week of 2026-06-29), then fell ~51% on month-end closes ($723 Jun -> $352 Nov) while fundamentals kept rising: FY2026 revenue $34.45B (+19%), Q4 $10.41B (+53%), Q1 FY27 guide $11.1B +/-0.5B (14 weeks) vs $11.41B consensus (srcs 1, 5, 6). The drawdown is a multiple reset (forward P/E 49x on 2026-06-30 to 21x on 2026-11-02, src 7) triggered by the investor-day omission of a WFE number (src 10), the post-midterm AI-capex scare (src 7) and a guide below consensus. (2) Base rate from AMAT's own 33-year monthly history (src 12): the first month a drawdown crossed -40% from the prior peak close occurred six times before now: Sep-2000 (-52% over the next 12 months), Jul-2002 (+31%), Oct-2008 (-5%), Sep-2015 (+105%), Oct-2018 (+65%), Jun-2022 (+59%). Median +45%, 4 of 6 positive, range -52% to +105%; the two losses came when industry revenue itself was rolling over (2001, 2009). Today revenue is rising and the 2027 WFE outlook is +30% or more (AMAT CEO Dickerson, TEL, Lam, Goldman: srcs 5-9), so the setup resembles 2015/2018/2022 more than 2000/2008. I still center below the base rate (+19%) because the 2026 spike left the stock with a peak-cycle earnings base, Kalshi prices a 20% chance of a 2027 US recession (src 14), and the project rule asks for a moderately conservative base. The wide historical dispersion sets the scenario widths: P10 $227 (-35% vs today), P90 $614 (+76%). (3) Model: Semi Systems = FY-mapped WFE (CY26 $155B, CY27 $205B, CY28 $225B, CY29 $220B; FY27 includes the 53rd week) x share 17.7-18.0%; AGS at 75% of the investor-day >$12B-by-2030 services path; Semi margin 38% / 38.5% / 37%; GAAP basis, SBC costed. FY2027 EPS ~$17.2 vs $18.75 consensus (-8%): we hold share flat and margin below the Q4 exit because output is supply-constrained and China falls below 25% (CFO Hill, src 6). CY28 WFE +10% vs Goldman +29% is the largest judgment call (GS path ~+18% on the target). (4) Valuation: P/E 19.1x (peer median 20.2x of KLAC/LRCX/ONTO, rebuilt table 2026-11-19, shrunk k=0.8 from own 18.8x) x NTM GAAP EPS ~$19.4 = $370; FCF yield 3.3% = $484; blend $415.83. Peer set is only 3 after the table rebuild (NVMI dropped; gap_note). (5) Sources: outside WFE forecasts are all from Aug-23 to Nov-13 2026 (GS 87 days, sell-side window 90; TEL 2026-10-30; Lam Oct-2026; AMAT CEO 2026-11-12); SEMI's Dec-2025 and Jul-2026 forecasts were not used since company statements overtook them, and SEMI publishes its next forecast in December 2026. Research was limited: the web-fetch budget ran out (Polymarket Taiwan and Kalshi Fed pages, Nasdaq consensus API and the full call transcript could not be read), so the 8-quarter guide record is thin (one period) and the set is annual, not quarterly.
